name: wastebin
description: A minimal pastebin for code and text, with highlighting and expiry

paths.name: Data
paths.description: wastebin's SQLite database with every paste, plus the signing key and salt. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: wastebin web page and API, published on host as 6896

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: WASTEBIN_BASE_URL
variables.description: The address you open wastebin at, used for the QR codes. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP address, like http://192.168.1.20:6896.

variables.name: WASTEBIN_MAX_BODY_SIZE
variables.description: Largest paste or upload in bytes. 1048576 is 1 MB.
